title: Intro to Synthesis Part 1 - The Building Blocks of Sound & Synthesis
summary: Dean Friedman's near-hour-long introduction to synthesis, covering the building blocks of sound and the controls on a synthesizer. He slowly adjusts knobs so viewers hear what each parameter does.
why: Repeatedly called the best beginner course on audio synthesis, since the concepts have not changed since it was made.

quote.text: It's the best educational video I've seen on YT
